usage.notes: Treat OpenSim as an isolated/offline biomechanics computation engine first. Do not add the native C++/Java/Python distribution to the main Vite browser bundle. Panacea web views should consume reviewed normalized simulation results or lightweight derived assets; interactive execution can be evaluated later behind a dedicated service/worker boundary if justified.

license.scope: The official opensim-org/opensim-core repository identifies Apache License 2.0 for the OpenSim core software. This does not automatically license musculoskeletal models, geometry, motion-capture files, marker trajectories, force-plate recordings, third-party plugins, datasets, publications or patient/athlete data processed by OpenSim.
license.notes: Preserve Apache-2.0/NOTICE obligations when redistributing OpenSim software or derivatives. Every model and input dataset requires its own provenance/license/privacy manifest.

validation.notes: OpenSim is a scientific musculoskeletal modeling and simulation platform, not a guarantee that a selected model represents a particular user. Joint loads, muscle forces, activation estimates, kinematics and kinetics depend on model anatomy, scaling, marker placement, external loads, filtering, assumptions, optimization/solver settings and measurement quality. Panacea must not present simulated outputs as measured truth or individualized clinical findings without separate validation.

provenance.authority: OpenSim / Stanford Neuromuscular Biomechanics Laboratory and open-source contributors
provenance.notes: Pin the OpenSim release and platform; baseline evaluation target is official release 4.6 (published 2026-07-09). Persist model filename/checksum/version, model source/citation/license, subject scaling inputs and scale factors, coordinate systems, marker-set definitions, marker trajectories and units, ground-reaction/external-load files, filtering/preprocessing, task/tool configuration, solver/optimizer settings, convergence diagnostics, output variables/units and all transformation steps.

adapter.notes: Planned gated flow: provenance-cleared generic or subject-specific model + motion/force inputs -> validation of units/coordinate systems/completeness -> pinned OpenSim 4.6 execution -> task-specific regression/quality checks -> PanaceaBiomechanicsSimulation -> lightweight charts/3D overlays. Preserve measured inputs separately from inferred/simulated outputs. Label inverse-kinematics, inverse-dynamics, static-optimization, Moco/optimal-control and forward-simulation outputs by method. Fail closed on non-convergence or missing required inputs; never fabricate a movement result to keep the UI animated.

trust.notes: High-authority open musculoskeletal simulation framework with clear software licensing and active releases. Evidence quality is deliberately low because the engine is not experimental evidence; scientific validity depends on each model, input dataset, assumptions and analysis workflow.
